howItWorks.label: Get Started
howItWorks.title: Live in under 15 minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No code. No consultants.

step1.title: Connect your channels
step1.desc: Link WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram — one setup flow, done in minutes.

step2.title: Feed the AI your knowledge
step2.desc: Upload docs, FAQs, brand guidelines. The co-pilot learns your voice so it sounds like you, not a chatbot.

step3.title: Set the rules
step3.desc: Define routing, assign departments, set SLA targets. The right message hits the right person, every time.

step4.title: Go live
step4.desc: Customers message you anywhere. Your team replies from one place with AI-powered suggestions and full context.

items.a: A single inbox for all your customer messaging — WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, email — with an AI co-pilot that helps your agents respond faster and smarter.
WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and email. More coming soon.

items.q: What does the AI co-pilot actually do?
items.a: It reads incoming messages, pulls relevant info from your knowledge base, and suggests replies your agents can send with one click. Think autocomplete, but for customer support.

items.q: How fast can we get started?
items.a: Most teams go live in under 15 minutes. Connect channels, upload your knowledge base, invite your team — done.
Encrypted in transit and at rest. We don't sell or share your data. Ever.
